items.title: Home Furnishing
items.description: Room-by-room furnishing for apartments and houses — mattresses, linens, curtains and rugs selected together so every room feels considered, not just filled.

items.title: Hotel & Resort Furnishing
items.description: Bulk, hospitality-grade furnishing programmes built for durability under daily guest turnover — coordinated by room type across an entire property.

items.title: Custom Furnishing Solutions
items.description: Bespoke fabric, sizing and finish choices for non-standard windows, beds or brand colour requirements — made to fit your space, not the other way round.

items.title: Fabric & Material Sourcing
items.description: Direct access to premium cotton, linen, velvet and blackout linings — sourced and sampled before you commit, for both single rooms and full hotel orders.

items.title: Bulk & Wholesale Supply
items.description: Volume pricing and staged deliveries for hotel groups, resorts and property developers furnishing multiple rooms or units at once.

items.title: Expert Consultation
items.description: One-on-one guidance from our specialists to match materials, textures and palettes to your project — in-store, on-site, or over a call.

items.title: Delivery
items.description: Scheduled, careful delivery across Pokhara and beyond — single-room drop-offs for homes, or staged floor-by-floor delivery for hotel projects.

items.title: Installation
items.description: Professional fitting by our trained team — curtain tracks, blinds and bedding set up and guest- or family-ready from day one.

items.title: After-Sales Care
items.description: Ongoing support for replacements, repairs and reordering — so hotels can maintain consistency and homeowners always know who to call.
